description: SWEPOS Nätverks-RTK-tjänst is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by lantmateriet.se. SWEPOS (Lantmäteriet's support system for satellite positioning in Sweden) network RTK service (Real-Time Kinematic) offers navigation support and positioning with centimetre accuracy in real time. Coverage: Sweden. The portal shows the English title as "SWEPOS Network RTK Service" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in OTHER. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://resources.geodata.se/codelist/metadata/anvandningsrestriktioner.xml#licensBehovs). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
